extracted.name: Hugo Spritz
extracted.description: Learn how to make a Hugo spritz! This Italian cocktail is bubbly, bright, herbaceous, and refreshing. I love sipping one on hot summer days.
ingredient_lines: 1 fresh mint sprig (plus more fresh mint for garnish)
½ ounce elderflower liqueur (such as St-Germain)
1 ounce club soda or sparkling water
instruction_lines: Place the mint sprig in a large wine glass. Add the elderflower liqueur and gently muddle. Set aside for 3 to 5 minutes to infuse.
Add ice to the glass, then pour in the prosecco and club soda and gently stir.
Garnish with fresh mint and a lemon wheel and serve.
